title: Student Discount Abuse
scenario: A site offers extra discounts if you upload passport and student card together.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Student Discount Abuse: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Do not over-share identity documents for small discounts.
